execution: Rotate weekly series across pillars: Metric Monday (Marketing Metrics), Teardown Tuesday (Competitive Advantage), War Story Wednesday (Sales Process), Thesis Thursday (Client Acquisition), Framework Friday (Content Strategy). Cycle through formats—teaching/contrarian/case study/listicle—ensuring each pillar receives multiple formats monthly. Track engagement metrics to identify top-performing concepts for deeper exploration and case studies.
